pages.text: Notebook, antimatter. Swap every particle for its antiparticle (C), reflect the world in a mirror (P), and run the film backwards (T). Do all three at once and the laws of physics come out exactly the same: CPT symmetry, as solid as anything we know.

So a universe of antimatter would be a universe like ours. The $(item)CPT Mirror$() opens onto one - the $(thing)Antiverse$(): continents of antistone under a copper sky, seas of antiwater, anti-ores in the rock.

Rule one: do not touch anything. Without a $(item)Penning Harness$() you annihilate in seconds. With one, you are wrapped in a field a hair thick that nothing crosses - except that the sea still burns. Fall off the bottom of the world and you come home.
Reverses charge, parity and time at once. Through it lies a universe exactly like ours, made of antimatter.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
A wearable Penning trap: magnetic and electric fields that keep every atom of you from touching the Antiverse.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.

$(thing)Dimension data: The Antiverse$()$(br2)$(thing)Nature$(): Gravity 1 g, 3 spatial dimensions, time x1, ordinary vacuum.$(br2)$(thing)Carry$(): $(item)Penning Harness$() - with it, antiwater still burns.
